Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface CubismModel

@CubismEditor public interface CubismModel
One Cubism model exposed as natural objects and methods.

The object graph is the single recommended parameter read/write plane: parameters() yields live Parameter objects whose Parameter.getValue() / Parameter.setValue(float) read and write the Editor authoring value. Immutable point-in-time views exist elsewhere — ParameterSnapshot inside facade snapshots and OwnedParameter inside the detached owned model — but none of them is a write handle.

      Returns the Editor model-instance list (host CModelSource.getModelInstances()).

      Read-only: instance creation and switching are Editor-internal operations with no verified authoring/undo evidence, so no write projection is declared.

      UnsupportedOperationException - when the backend does not expose model instances

    • animationDocuments

      default List<AnimationDocument> animationDocuments()
      Returns the model's animation file-content documents.

      No stable Editor document entry exists for auto-face evaluation state, so no auto-face projection is declared; see the adapter evidence records. Animation scene add/delete (CAnimationFileContent.addScene / deleteScene / setCurrentSceneDoc) has no reviewed Undo registration in Cubism 5.2.03, 5.3.02, or 5.3.03, so scene writes stay unavailable (fail closed).

      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - when the backend does not expose animation documents

    • textures

      default ModelTextures textures()
      Returns the model's texture library projection.

      Reads expose the Editor's CTextureManager document state (raw images, model image groups, texture atlases); writes are Editor-authoring operations inside the native Undo envelope.

      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - when the backend does not expose the texture library

    • renderPixels

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default CubismRenderedPixels renderPixels(int width, int height)
      Renders the current model document state into an offscreen raster of widthxheight pixels using the Editor's own renderer, and returns an owned immutable copy of the pixels.

      This is a read of document state: the current parameter set of the active model instance is rendered, never a stored or synthetic frame. The call fails when the host cannot produce the raster, when the raster does not match the requested dimensions, or when the temporary render instance cannot be observed to leave the model unchanged — no cached, cropped, rescaled or fallback image is ever substituted.

    • exportMoc

      @CubismEditor(from="5.3.00") default CubismMocExport exportMoc(CubismMocExportSettings settings)
      Exports MOC 5.3 bytes and atlas textures through the official Editor exporter. The model must already have a valid atlas. The exporter works on its own copy; it does not save files or add an Undo entry to the current document. All settings are explicit and the returned data is bounded and owned by the caller.
